defect: The change closes a JSON file right after its last buffer via CloseJSONFile, which spins until requested_reads == actual_reads, but the counters it added are never incremented on the cached-read path and never reset by Reset, so a scan reset deadlocks.
reason: The fix adds actual_reads++ on the cache path, resets both counters and moves the close call; all of this repairs machinery introduced by this change.

defect: The added D_ASSERT(state.ht_index < finalized_hts.size()) reads the shared state.ht_index without the lock, so another thread advancing it past the end makes the assertion fire spuriously in debug builds.
reason: The fix asserts on the local ht_index instead; the racy assertion is a line this change added.

defect: ca_cert_file is a std::string_view (C++17, read via GetValue<std::string_view>, dangling or not compiling) and the returned HTTPParams omits enable_server_cert_verification and ca_cert_file, so the new settings are ignored.
reason: The fix switches to string via ToString and passes both new fields in the return value, repairing lines this change added.

defect: The new optimizer assumes the bound min/max aggregate has one child, but for collated VARCHAR columns min/max binds to arg_min/arg_max with two children, breaking the pushdown; dynamic filters are also attached to the get before a possible bail-out.
reason: The fix bails out when the aggregate has other than one child and moves the dynamic filter setup after it; the collation rewrite in minmax already existed at the change.

defect: The new occupancy estimate multiplies distinct counts of group columns across all grouping sets, so with GROUPING SETS/CUBE the product explodes (to inf), the 1-exp term becomes 0 and the estimate degenerates to 0 or NaN.
reason: The fix uses only the grouping set with the most columns and handles a zero multiplier; the flattened product was added by this change.

defect: LogStorageScanState has no virtual destructor (and is not polymorphic for DynamicCastCheck) although InMemoryLogStorageScanState, holding a ColumnDataScanState, is owned and deleted through unique_ptr<LogStorageScanState>.
reason: Deleting a derived object through a non-virtual base destructor is undefined behaviour and leaks the scan state; the fix adds the virtual destructor and override.

defect: The added FlatVector::SetValidity(result, FlatVector::Validity(source)) runs even when source and result are constant (or dictionary) vectors, tripping the flat-vector assertions and copying the wrong mask.
reason: The fix sets invalid rows per element via Orrify for both constant and flat results; the faulty line is the one this change added.

defect: ConflictManager now defaults to THROW mode and ShouldThrow returns true when no conflict set exists, so foreign key verification, which passes a ConflictInfo and expects hits to be recorded, throws on every matching key.
reason: The fix sets SCAN mode in VerifyForeignKeyConstraint and initializes the conflicts selection; the THROW default and ShouldThrow logic come from this change.

defect: The new default ManagedSelection() leaves size at 0 while uninitialized, so a foreign key check with no matches yields an empty selection and FirstMissingMatch, which iterates Size(), cannot find the missing row.
reason: The fix replaces the default constructor with ManagedSelection(size, initialize) so an uninitialized selection still carries the input size.

defect: Changing && to || makes sqlite3_column_bytes return 0 unless both the text and the blob conversion succeed, and forces a VARCHAR to BLOB cast for every text column.
reason: The fix reverts the operator to &&; the wrong condition is exactly what this change introduced.

defect: The state member is declared as map<T, size_t> *map, reusing the unqualified duckdb::map template name inside the class (GCC rejects this as changing the meaning of map), and the chunk_collection include was dropped although ChunkCollection is still used.
reason: The fix renames the member to hist and restores the include; the result.type to GetType() edits are merge adaptation, but the build break comes from this change.

defect: Collapsing untouched candidate lists to VARCHAR during first-chunk dialect detection removes the other candidates before the later sample-refinement loop, so a column that is NULL only in the first chunk is forced to VARCHAR.
reason: The fix moves the default-to-VARCHAR decision to the final type selection after refinement; the premature collapse was added here.

defect: Evaluating every foldable child with EvaluateScalar at bind time throws errors (division by zero, failing casts) for expressions that would otherwise never be evaluated or would be optimized away.
reason: The fix uses TryEvaluateScalar and skips children that fail; the throwing evaluation was introduced by this change.

defect: InitializeScan now keeps an existing state.file_handle, but the scan state is reused across files in a multi-file parquet scan, so later files are read through the first file's handle.
reason: The fix restores opening the reader's own file on every InitializeScan; the reuse guard was added by this change.

defect: On a metadata-cache hit HTTPFileHandle::Initialize returns early before read_buffer is allocated, so later reads use a null buffer.
reason: The fix allocates read_buffer on the cache-hit path; the early return was introduced by this change.

defect: NextSingleJoin gathers the build-side values (setting NULL bits for NULL payloads) and then calls nullmask.set() and clears the bits of matched rows, overwriting the NULLs so NULL build values appear as garbage.
reason: The fix sets the mask first and gathers afterwards; the ordering is in the new single-join code.

defect: RepeatFunctionData's new constructor takes value but never initializes the value member, so repeat() outputs a default NULL value.
reason: The fix adds value(move(value)) to the initializer list.

defect: The new LogicalGet constructor initializes names(move(names)), self-moving the member instead of using returned_names, so the column names are lost.
reason: The fix initializes names from returned_names.

defect: The new heuristic treats a '?' suffix that contains a '.' as part of the key, so real query parameters such as an endpoint host name are misparsed into the path.
reason: The fix always splits the query at the last '?'; the dot heuristic was added by this change.

defect: The added guard throws when column_ids.size() > 1, but column_ids lists every column referenced by the index expressions, so single-key expression indexes over several columns are wrongly rejected.
reason: The fix checks expression_types.size() instead; the wrong guard is a line this change added.

defect: The rewritten Skip calls LoadGroup before ScanGroup, which loads the same group again when the group is fresh, double-advancing metadata_ptr and corrupting later scans (the group loop also lacked an increment).
reason: The fix removes the extra LoadGroup call in Skip, a line introduced by this change.

defect: Making target_length signed lets index 0 or negative list_select indices (sel_idx < 0) pass the < target_length check and select input_offset plus a negative offset, an out-of-bounds read, instead of NULL.
reason: The fix reverts to the unsigned comparison under which negative indices wrap and yield NULL.

defect: Await reads the non-atomic done flag in while (!done) and resets it outside the mutex, a data race with Signal.
reason: The fix waits and resets done while holding the lock; the racy loop is new in this change.

defect: ExpressionEqualityMatcher::Match compares the stored expression with itself (expr names the member, the parameter expr_ is ignored) and pushes the member, so it matches any expression.
reason: The fix renames the member so the argument is compared and bound.

defect: The new re-entrant TryFlushCachingOperators advances flushing_idx whenever should_reflush_current_operator is false, even when in_process_operators remain after a blocked sink, skipping pending output of the current operator.
reason: The fix only advances when no in-process operators remain; the flawed re-entry logic was introduced by this refactor.

defect: The fix appends the 63- and 64-bit entries to BITPACK_MASKS; bit widths 63 and 64 already indexed past the end of the previous 32-entry table.
reason: The change extended the mask table from 32 to 63 entries; the still-missing entries were missing before, so the defect predates this change.

defect: The added D_ASSERT(!child_validity.IsMaskSet()) plus Initialize assume the array child has no validity mask yet, which fails and discards state when the result vector's child already carries a mask.
reason: The fix replaces the assertion and Initialize with Resize; both lines were added by this change.

defect: The new header includes an internal header with angle brackets (<duckdb/storage/checkpoint/string_checkpoint_state.hpp>) and is not self-contained, which breaks builds that do not use src/include as a system path, such as the amalgamation.
reason: The fix replaces the angle-bracket include with the needed quoted includes to fix CI; the faulty include list comes from this change.

defect: Interpreted benchmarks are only registered inside run_benchmarks, but --list is handled earlier in parse_arguments (and exits), so interpreted benchmarks are missing from the list.
reason: The fix loads interpreted benchmarks in main before argument parsing; the misplaced loading was added by this change.

defect: The fix only changes the NotImplementedException text from 'delete' to 'update'.
reason: The change throws the intended exception for materialized CTEs in UPDATE; the wrong word in the message is cosmetic, not a functional defect.

defect: tableref is a unique_ptr<TableRef>, so the added tableref.external_dependency does not compile.
reason: The fix uses tableref->external_dependency; the compile error is in the line this change added.

defect: Passing target_scale instead of round_value to RoundPrecisionFunctionData makes negative precisions arrive as 0 in DecimalRoundNegativePrecisionFunction, so ROUND(decimal, -n) returns wrong results.
reason: The fix restores round_value and corrects the early-out bound instead; the wrong argument was introduced by this change.

defect: The added sqlite3_keyword_check stub prints 'unsupported' to stderr and always returns 0, so the upgraded shell's .dump, which uses it to quote identifiers, emits noise and leaves keywords unquoted.
reason: The fix implements the function via Parser::IsKeyword, replacing the stub this change added.

defect: The reimplemented DBP decoder discards each block's min_delta, bounds the copy by batch_size instead of the remaining count (overrunning the target), keeps previous_value unsigned, and routes Finalize through GetBatch's read_values check.
reason: The fix assigns min_delta, bounds next by batch_size - target_values_offset, makes previous_value signed and splits off GetBatchInternal.

defect: ContainsGeneric's exit test offset > haystack_size - needle_size lets the loop read haystack[haystack_size] and compare a window past the end, an out-of-bounds read that can produce false matches.
reason: The fix changes the test to >=; the off-by-one is in the new search routine.

defect: The new Value::ToSQLString wraps VARCHAR values in single quotes without escaping embedded quotes, producing invalid or wrong SQL.
reason: The fix doubles embedded single quotes in the VARCHAR branch added by this change.

defect: SwizzleBlocks merges the new blocks into swizzled_block_collection first and then loops over all of its blocks, so a second call re-swizzles already processed blocks and misaligns the heap blocks (whose counts are also set to 0).
reason: The fix iterates only over the new block_collection, sets the heap block counts and merges afterwards.

defect: SwizzleCollectedBlocks moves the collected blocks into swizzled_block_collection and then loops over all swizzled blocks, re-swizzling blocks from earlier calls when invoked more than once.
reason: The fix replaces the routine with AlignHeapBlocks, which processes only the newly collected blocks; the loop over the whole swizzled collection originates here.

defect: IntervalConvert writes Interval::GetMilli values into a timedelta64[ns] NumPy array, so intervals come out a million times too small.
reason: The fix converts with Interval::GetNanoseconds; the unit mismatch was introduced by this change.

defect: After switching to duckdb_result, release still calls duckdb_destroy_arrow on a duckdb_result pointer, get_schema leaks the column logical types, and StatementRelease destroys a never-initialized (malloc'd) result that may also be owned by the handed-out stream.
reason: The fix destroys the result in release, frees the logical types and drops the destroy in StatementRelease, all defects from this change.
